Join us at Tennessee State University for Spring Preview Day on April 11 at 9:00 AM and experience TSU through the eyes of a Tiger. Prospective students and their families will have the opportunity to learn more about our academic programs, scholarship opportunities, campus resources, and student life while connecting with admissions staff and current students.💙

Register here:
https://apply.tnstate.edu/register/springpreviewday2026 | Tennessee State University Admissions | Facebook
